info.title: Finalechat API
info.summary: The app where agents message the user.
info.description: Threads of messages and questions between agent sessions and one user, with long-polling, server-sent events and Web Push. Human-readable reference: https://www.finalechat.com/api/ . Agent quick start: https://www.finalechat.com/AGENTS.md .

get.description: text/event-stream of `ready`, `thread.created`, `thread.updated`, `thread.deleted`, `message.created`, `question.created`, `question.answered`, `question.cancelled`, `question.expired`, `settings.updated` and `reconnect` events. Each data payload carries the full current objects (`thread`, `message`, `question`, `settings`) plus `counts` and `at`. A `: ping` comment is sent every 20 seconds.

get.summary: List messages, or wait for new ones

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Return messages newer than this id (ascending). Required with wait.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Return messages older than this id (ascending).

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Seconds to hold the request open for a message newer than `after`. Clamped to 600.

200.description: Messages in ascending order. `has_more` reports older messages (or newer ones beyond limit when using after). `timed_out` is true when a wait elapsed with nothing new.

bearerAuth.description: API token created in the app under Settings → Agents. Usually supplied as the FINALECHAT_TOKEN environment variable.

sessionCookie.name: fc_session
sessionCookie.description: Browser session set by POST /auth/login. State-changing requests must be same-origin.

Meta.description: Free-form JSON object stored verbatim; at most 16 KiB.

notify_all_messages.description: Push for every agent message, not only important ones and questions.

remote_mode.description: The user is away from the terminal; integrations should block for phone replies and answers.

prefix.description: First 11 characters of the secret, safe to display.

unread_threads.description: Active threads with at least one unread non-user message.

external_id.description: Caller-chosen id; usable as ext:<external_id> in paths.

last_activity_at.description: Bumped by every message and question.

preview.description: Plain-text excerpt of the latest message or question.
